name: kicad2ant
description: Simulate the printed antenna of the open board in openEMS: S11, band, gain, pattern. KiCad 10.
description_full:
kicad2ant simulates the printed antenna on the open KiCad board with openEMS (a free FDTD solver, run through GNU Octave).

- Reads the antenna footprint's copper, the ground net's zones, tracks and vias, the stackup and the board outline. Nothing is entered by hand.
- Reports S11, input impedance, the -10 dB band against your target band, gain, efficiency and the radiation pattern, plus a Touchstone .s1p for matching-network design.
- Check model draws the model in seconds, so you can see the port and the ground before a real run.
- Fills the zones and runs on a copy of the board: your board file is not changed.

Needs GNU Octave and openEMS installed (both free). Only the antenna footprint and the ground net are modelled; the board is bare, in air. KiCad 10 action plugin (SWIG runtime).
